caption: 💌 SAVE this recipe to always have a calm, real food snack ready Why settle for processed toddler snacks when you can make these real-food Apple Fig Bars? 🍎 Soft, naturally sweet, and made with pure, wholesome ingredients, these bars are perfect for a calm, connected snack time. Recipe: 1 grated apple 🍏 ½ cup (80g) dried figs, soaked and mashed 🌿 2 eggs 🥚 ⅓ cup (40g) chickpea flour ⅓ cup (40g) whole wheat flour 1 tsp baking powder ¼ tsp cinnamon Mix all ingredients in a 12×18 cm baking pan and bake at 180°C until golden and firm. These bars are soft, naturally sweet, and made with real food ...no junk, no stress. Perfect for toddlers and busy moms alike. #ToddlerSnacks #RealFoodForToddlers #HealthySnackIdeas #AppleFigBars    #EnergiKuatTiapLangkah
